summary: The Lounge (thelounge) is a self-hosted web IRC client: a socket.io/express server that persists each user's chat networks/channels/settings/sessions in per-user JSON files, archived chat messages in a per-user SQLite DB (or text logs), uploaded files on disk, link-preview media in a content-addressed storage folder, and per-host IRC STS policies in a JSON file. It exposes CLI user-management commands, socket.io RPCs for network/session/settings/message CRUD, and HTTP endpoints for uploads.
